items.title: Why only a 1.4% band satisfies both '>70%' and 'no shorter than -250'
items.detail: A fair price of -250 is a decimal 1.400, i.e. a 71.43% implied chance. Any selection our model rates above 71.43% is therefore necessarily shorter than -250, and any selection rated below 70.00% is not a >70% pick. The only overlap is a model probability of 0.7000-0.7143 (fair 1.4000-1.4286). Board AF publishes every 70%+ selection it finds even when the price is shorter than -250 (the match-winner pick column), and it builds the five-per-sport prediction set from the highest-probability selections that do sit inside -250 to +10,000.

items.title: EHF fixture list read from a client-rendered page; raw capture holds only the page shell
items.detail: The EHF Champions League matches page renders its fixture cards in JavaScript. The committed raw capture (SHA-256 in the manifest) contains the page shell, so the seven 28 October fixtures were read from the rendered page on 2026-10-22T21:05Z and are transcribed into desk.json with the printed CET times. Standings (the model inputs) are server-rendered and fully reproducible from the capture.

items.title: SuperLega had played one round when the desk was built
items.detail: Only one match per club was in the official classifica at capture time, so every rate is shrunk hard toward the league average (k=8). The five volleyball picks are published with Medium/Low labels, not High, and the model probability on each is disclosed.

items.title: No official probable pitcher published for the World Series games at capture time
items.detail: The MLB postseason schedule feed carried no probablePitcher for the games listed, so the run model is team-level only (runs scored/allowed over 162 games). If a probable pitcher is announced, the numbers should be re-run before staking.

items.title: Top 14 two-way lines fold the modelled draw into both sides
items.detail: Top 14 matches can be drawn. Board AF quotes a two-way half-line market and folds the draw probability into both sides using the normal margin assumption, rather than pretending draws do not exist. The draw is included in the model total of 1.0.
